answers.sql: SELECT h.amount_million - q.amount_million AS value FROM expenses h JOIN expenses q ON h.entity=q.entity WHERE h.entity='Tesla' AND h.year=2024 AND h.metric='R&D' AND h.period='H1' AND q.entity='Tesla' AND q.year=2024 AND q.metric='R&D' AND q.period='Q2'

SELECT (q.amount_million - (h.amount_million - q.amount_million)) * 100.0 / (h.amount_million - q.amount_million) AS value FROM expenses h JOIN expenses q ON h.entity=q.entity WHERE h.entity='Tesla' AND h.year=2024 AND h.metric='R&D' AND h.period='H1' AND q.entity='Tesla' AND q.year=2024 AND q.metric='R&D' AND q.period='Q2'
